description: Convert a CSS color string into a canonical hex, rgb, hsl, or oklch format string.

input.description: CSS color string to convert, e.g. "#ff0000", "tomato" (max 256 chars)

to.description: Target color format to convert the input into

name: convert_color

result.description: The input color formatted in the requested target format (oklch is raw/lossless; hex/rgb/hsl are sRGB-clamped for out-of-gamut inputs)
